title: Phone Vibrate
blurb: Three pulses against a hard surface, and everybody in the room reaches for a pocket. Nothing summons universal low-grade panic quite like this — the reflex is beneath conscious control, which is exactly why it remains the most reliable prank sound available anywhere. The buzz-pause-buzz cadence is what sells it; a continuous drone reads as an appliance, whereas this reads as somebody wanting something from you. Also genuinely useful in edits to show an incoming call without lifting any real handset's audio. Low frequency, authentic table rattle, entirely original.
origin: Original synthesis of a phone vibrating on a hard surface, buzz-pause cadence.
